subject: reasoning
question:
Two different positions of the same dice are given below. Which is the number on the face opposite to the face containing 1?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5fdfe6622bc78f8355cdb170e1ac06c79d047809e9d2f47eac0cd22b3379b38f.png]
solution:
Given,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f55d76d4b7e450753cfbccf2c7249c6094f2853e8acd3800c47603d4c712c092.png] 

From the two positions of the dice, the common number is **6**.

By rotating clockwise from the common number 6 in both figures:

 
• Figure 1: 6 → 5 → 4
 
• Figure 2: 6 → 3 → 2

The pairs of opposite faces are:

 
• 5 is opposite 3
 
• 4 is opposite 2

The only number remaining is **1**, which must be opposite the common number **6**.

Therefore, the number on the face opposite to the face containing 1 is **6**.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
